name: nadesiko3-ai
description: AI-Enhanced Japanese Programming Language with Data Science Capabilities

scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:node && npm run test:common
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:async && npm run test:e
scripts.test:global: npm run test:all && npm run test:python && npm run test:web
scripts.build: npm run build:tsc && npm run build:nako_version && npm run build:tsc && npm run build:command && npm run build:esbuild && node src/cnako3.mjs batch/calc_hash.nako3
scripts.clean: npm run build:tsc && node src/cnako3.mjs batch/clean.nako3
scripts.build:command: cross-env REPORT_ERR=1 npm run check:command && node src/cnako3.mjs batch/build_command.nako3
scripts.publish:desc: node -e "console.log('Please exec => npm run build && npm run test:all && npm publish && npm run publish:version')
scripts.publish:version: node src/cnako3.mjs batch/publish_version.nako3 && node src/cnako3.mjs batch/copy_core.nako3
scripts.eslint: eslint src/*.mts core/src/*.mts src/plugin_datascience.mjs src/plugin_statistics.mjs src/plugin_machinelearning.mjs src/plugin_python_compatibility.mjs src/plugin_web_enhancement.mjs src/plugin_drone_navigation_gpsfree.mjs
scripts.demo:all: npm run demo:datascience && npm run demo:python && npm run demo:web
scripts.demo:drone:all: npm run demo:drone && npm run demo:drone:en
scripts.build:datascience: echo 'Data Science plugins are ready for deployment'
scripts.package:datascience: mkdir -p dist/datascience && cp src/plugin_datascience.mjs src/plugin_statistics.mjs src/plugin_machinelearning.mjs dist/datascience/ && cp demo/datascience_demo.nako3 dist/datascience/ && cp README_DATASCIENCE.md dist/datascience/
scripts.package:python: mkdir -p dist/python && cp src/plugin_python_compatibility.mjs dist/python/ && cp demo/python_compatibility_demo.nako3 demo/python_compatibility_demo_en.nako3 dist/python/ && cp README_DEPLOYMENT.md dist/python/
scripts.package:web: mkdir -p dist/web && cp src/plugin_web_enhancement.mjs dist/web/ && cp demo/web_enhancement_demo.nako3 demo/web_enhancement_demo_en.nako3 dist/web/
scripts.package:all: npm run package:datascience && npm run package:python && npm run package:web && npm run package:drone
scripts.package:drone: mkdir -p dist/drone && cp src/plugin_drone_navigation_gpsfree.mjs dist/drone/ && cp demo/drone_navigation_gpsfree_demo.nako3 demo/drone_navigation_gpsfree_demo_en.nako3 dist/drone/ && cp README_DEPLOYMENT.md dist/drone/
scripts.deploy:staging: echo 'Deploying to staging environment...' && docker-compose -f docker-compose.staging.yml up -d
scripts.deploy:production: echo 'Deploying to production environment...' && docker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
scripts.deploy:global: echo 'Deploying to global infrastructure...' && docker-compose -f docker-compose.global.yml up -d

keywords: 日本語プログラミング言語
author: rabbit-hand
